name: M'Baku

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.True Accuracy: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Kaçış (Evade) etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Cleanse: Bu etkiye sahip şampiyon bir debuff aldığında, debuff anında arındırılır ve Cleanse kaldırılır.
abilityDetails.Adrenaline: Zamanla azalan beyaz bir can barı olarak depolanır. Saldırılarla verilen hasar, depolanan Adrenaline'i cana çevirir; bu dönüşüm İyileşme Engeli gibi etkilerden etkilenmez.

signatureAbility:
The Fearless One
While Unstoppable, M'Baku gains +[15 - 35]% Combat Adrenaline.
When an Opponent's Evade or Auto-Block fails due to True Accuracy, M'Baku deals a burst of [10,364 Direct Damage. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
Reaching 50 Combo Meter for the first time each fight indefinitely increases the duration of M'Baku's personal Furies by [10 - 25]%.

abilitySections.title: Ghekre's Mighty Roar
content: M'Baku has 100% Resistance to Coldsnap along with immunity to Frostbite effects.

After finishing a Heavy Attack, M'Baku stands still for 0.75 seconds, releasing a Mighty Roar that grants him a non-stacking +[2,591] Fury Passive for 22 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
As a Defender, M'Baku has a 60% chance to gain this Fury after performing a Heavy Attack.
While a personal Fury is active, M'Baku's attacks have a 35% chance to inflict a [2,591] Bleed Debuff for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Overwhelming Stampede
content: While a personal Fury is active, Dashing forwards from outside striking distance grants an Unstoppable Passive for 2 seconds, paused for the duration of the Dash.

This Unstoppable is removed and can't be activated during the Opponent's Special Attacks. After the final hit of their Special, it can be triggered by Dashing forward, or by performing a Medium Attack within striking distance.
While Unstoppable, M'Baku gains a Combo Shield Passive.
While Unstoppable, all his hits grant +1 Combo Meter.
Striking the Opponent with Basic Attacks pauses this Unstoppable for 0.2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Ghekre's Blessings - Combo Meter Abilities
content: M'Baku unlocks additional abilities as his Combo Meter increases.
Every 10 hits in his Combo Meter, M'Baku gains a True Accuracy Passive for 5 seconds, paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
While at 20 or more Combo Meter, M'Baku's Unstoppable is paused during his Special Attack 1 and Strikers.
While at 40 or more Combo Meter, all hits while M'Baku's Unstoppable is active gain up to +[22.73] Critical Rating scaling with M'Baku's Combo Meter, maxing at 75 Combo.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Fury of the Jabari
content: On activation, refresh all personal Furies.
The first and final hits each Purify 2 non-Damaging Debuffs on M'Baku, granting +2 Combo Meter for each Debuff Purified this way.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Hammer's Blow
content: Each hit deals a burst of Direct Damage equal to 15% of all the damage the Opponent has taken prior to this attack while M'Baku's personal Unstoppable is active, up to [75,657.2] damage per hit scaling with his starting Attack. Damage counting resets after the final hit.
On the final hit, consume 100 Combo Meter to gain M'Baku's Mighty Roar Fury.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Ghekre's Grace
content: Purify all Debuffs and gain a non-stacking +[1,036.4] Fury Passive for 60 seconds with +10% flat potency per Debuff Purified. Max potency increase: +40%.
Gain +5 Combo Meter and an indefinite Cleanse Passive for each Debuff Purified this way. Max Cleanses: 5.
